disambiguation: Not a cloud service; it uses a direct, token-protected connection between your own devices.
extras: The desktop server also serves a mobile-friendly web page, allowing file transfer with zero install. It is LAN first, with public access optional via a one-command HTTPS tunnel.
motivation: The author built it as a spare-time project to save users hassle when moving files between their computer and phone.
problem: Moving vault files between a desktop computer and a mobile device often requires manual processes or reliance on third-party cloud services.
summary: A token-protected bridge that allows users to upload and download vault files between a desktop server and a mobile client over a URL.
